description.p: QLInux designs labels on a real canvas (text, images, barcodes, QR codes), shows an exact monochrome print preview and prints straight to the printer, over the network or USB.
QLInux entwirft Etiketten auf einer echten Arbeitsfläche (Text, Bilder, Barcodes, QR-Codes), zeigt eine exakte einfarbige Druckvorschau und druckt direkt auf den Drucker, über das Netzwerk oder USB.
Select several database rows and print them together. Pinch to zoom the canvas. Network printers are checked over SNMP, and the loaded tape is remembered. AppImages for x86_64 and aarch64.

Tables, date and time stamps, clip art, shapes and richer text. A CSV database with record ranges and numbering. Printing opens as a sheet. Light and dark appearance, ruler guides, copy and paste, and in-app help.
Several labels as tabs in one window, align menu in the toolbar, undo and redo icons, and Brother .lbx import. Several fixes for printing, rotation, large images and the inspector.
Fixes for cutting, margins and the save/open dialog, plus a stacked right panel when there is room.
